title: Play UNO SHOW ‘EM NO MERCY Anywhere! (Data Pack)
description: Play UNO and draw 10 cards to your friend in Minecraft because why not?
body:
# Play UNO SHOW ‘EM NO MERCY Anywhere! (Data Pack)

Have you ever imagined playing UNO in Minecraft? Now, your dream comes true – not only classic UNO, but UNO SHOW ‘EM NO MERCY!

**This game requires the [“Play UNO SHOW ‘EM NO MERCY Anywhere” resource pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/play-uno-senm-anywhere-rp) to function correctly.**

![The image shows the full deck of UNO SHOW ‘EM NO MERCY cards (duplicated cards ignored)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4092a8f4e4631c3d4bade8ae4c2a5d4d386eccea.png)

## How to Play

For the rules of UNO SHOW ‘EM NO MERCY, please visit [this page](https://service.mattel.com/instruction_sheets/HVW18-Eng.pdf).

### Installation

There is a page on Minecraft Wiki guiding you to [install this data pack](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Tutorial:Installing_a_data_pack).

With the data pack installed, press Quick Actions key (default `G`) to open the interface.

Besides, this game requires the [“Play UNO SHOW ‘EM NO MERCY Anywhere” resource pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/play-uno-senm-anywhere-rp) to function correctly. **BOTH the data pack and the resource pack have to be installed or loaded to play.**

### Gameplay

After selecting “Place Table”, each player can press Use Item/Place Block key (default `RIght Button`) at Note Block to obtain the required amount of cards.

> Tips: use “/say @r” to randomly select a player to start the game.

When it comes to your turn, place the card you want to play on the Item Frame in front of you.

If there has been a card on Item frame already, then clear it. The card cleaned will be collected into Barrel automatically.

> Tips: if you want to play “Discard All”, make sure it is placed on the Item Frame in the end.

When you cannot obtain cards using the Note Block, select “Shuffle” to shuffle the remaining cards.

## Features

* Nice pixel-styled cards, withdrawn with care
* User-friendly options interface and table
* Real-time card counting, so that you won’t miss any opportunity to catch those forgotton to yell “UNO”
* Placing a card on off-hand to display it
